metadata.name: gmsol_evm_proxy
metadata.description: GMX-Solana is an extension of GMX on the Solana blockchain.

docs: EVM proxy instructions.

instructions.name: create_proxy_idempotent
docs: Create a permanent proxy, or validate an existing proxy without changing it.
The payer gains no authority over the proxy.
# Accounts
*[See the documentation for the accounts.](CreateProxyIdempotent).*
# Arguments
- `evm_address`: Raw EVM address identifying the proxy.
# Errors
- [`ProxyError::InvalidProxy`] if an existing proxy has a different version,
bump, or EVM address.
- Anchor seed/account validation or System account creation fails.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent but has no authority over the proxy.

accounts.name: proxy
docs: Permanent PDA for the supplied EVM address.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program used to allocate a new proxy.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Invoke the program scaffold without creating or changing a proxy.
# Accounts
*[See the documentation for the accounts.](Initialize).*
# Arguments
None.
# Errors
- Anchor account validation fails for invalid accounts.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Caller signing the scaffold invocation.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program.

errors.name: InvalidProxy
errors.msg: Proxy account data does not match its EVM address

types.name: Proxy
